task: Add a --print-config (dry-run) flag to codemie-opencode that prints the generated opencode config to console and exits without starting opencode.

key_reasoning.reason: Touches AgentCLI.ts (CLI/Commander layer) and BaseAgentAdapter.ts (core adapter orchestration), both shared across every agent CLI (claude, codex, gemini, kimi, opencode), plus opencode.plugin.ts (plugin layer) which must expose its closure-local config object instead of only leaking it via env-var side effect. Base fits L (3-4 components, 2-3 layers, shared utilities involved); bumped to XL because the change carries cross-agent blast radius.

No exact precedent for a print-only/dry-run flag on this CLI; the generated config can carry real credentials (provider apiKey/headers fields) that must be redacted before printing — a genuine security requirement on top of the standard 'new pattern, may need feature flag' baseline. Zero existing test coverage for beforeRun config assembly, temp-config.ts, or opencode-specific CLI parsing compounds the risk.

red_flags_applied: Component Scope bumped from L (4) to XL (5): affects multiple workflows/agents — AgentCLI.ts and BaseAgentAdapter.ts are shared core code used by every agent CLI, not just opencode
Technical Risk bumped from M (3) to L (4): security requirement — generated config may embed real credentials (provider headers/apiKey) that must be redacted before console output
